dedupe_keys.name: surewave economic assessment cost model and financial analysis for offshore floating pv deliverable d7 4

description: Eirik, Larsen and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The actual Excel model evaluates 2 MW, 10 MW modular and 10 MW full-scale offshore-PV configurations in Mediterranean, Baltic and North Sea scenarios. It includes capital/operating cost breakdowns, a fifty-year energy/degradation horizon and module replacement at year 25. Outputs include LCOE, NPV, IRR and payback under base, pessimistic and optimistic assumptions. Sensitivities cover discount rates, cabling and structural variants. The workbook formulas and solver behaviour were not inspected; source-code openness remains unknown. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The model accompanies the SUREWAVE D7.4 economic assessment.
